title: Reopen completed ad hoc work and its follow-ups under one identity

intentCoverage.report:
**Verdict — Caught.** The maintained backend assertion caught a stale native update erasing both the original Done story attachment and the saved published association.

For `SEED-420#review-standalone-done-work` at `d10fa47d6da1747788c3ac58d6045409f02b355c`, probe the promise that a late native update preserves the Done attachment and selected association. G2 traces that promise to the story clause that marking an ad hoc session Done with no story creates a Done story and attaches the session to it. [Story](/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.worktrees/reopen-completed-ad-hoc-work-and-its-follow-ups/.planning/seeds/SEED-420-unified-intent-review.md#review-standalone-done-work) · [Plan G2](/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.worktrees/reopen-completed-ad-hoc-work-and-its-follow-ups/.planning/slice-plans/756-reopen-completed-ad-hoc-work/PLAN.md:356)

In a detached scratch checkout, one fault changed `updateRecord` to carry forward only `doneAt` and `doneProblem` from the saved Done evidence. The existing fixture chose the published association and then supplied an older native record. The direct persisted-record read immediately after `await updateRecord(source, stale)` was the assertion that caught it. Its received record kept `doneAt` but lacked `doneStory` for `ad-hoc#22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222` and `storyAssociationChoice` with `selected: "published"` and `published: "SEED-42#already-published"`. This verdict covers the stale `updateRecord` path. [Fault patch](/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.git/worktrees/reopen-completed-ad-hoc-work-and-its-follow-ups/open-dough/evidence/intent-coverage.ROkazw/fault.patch) · [Assertion](/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.worktrees/reopen-completed-ad-hoc-work-and-its-follow-ups/dashboard/backend-tests/review/ad-hoc-done-story-association.spec.ts:174) · [Fault run](/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.git/worktrees/reopen-completed-ad-hoc-work-and-its-follow-ups/open-dough/evidence/intent-coverage.ROkazw/fault.log)

The same case ran on AC power using the macOS sleep guard and one worker for each phase. The case record confirmed exactly one selected test each time, with strict results of passed, failed at the persisted-record assertion, and passed after restoration. Fixtures and assertions stayed untouched. The source file matched its pre-probe bytes, the restored Git status matched the initially clean status, and the scratch worktree was removed and unregistered. [Baseline](/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.git/worktrees/reopen-completed-ad-hoc-work-and-its-follow-ups/open-dough/evidence/intent-coverage.ROkazw/baseline.log) · [Restored run](/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.git/worktrees/reopen-completed-ad-hoc-work-and-its-follow-ups/open-dough/evidence/intent-coverage.ROkazw/restored.log) · [Cleanup record](/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.git/worktrees/reopen-completed-ad-hoc-work-and-its-follow-ups/open-dough/evidence/intent-coverage.ROkazw/cleanup)
